info.title: AgentXM Registry API
info.description: Public machine-client API for AgentXM auth, discovery, extension and Library reads, publishing, and user-initiated lifecycle operations.

200.description: Registry service metadata including health status and documentation entry points.

get.description: Returns service metadata and documentation entrypoints when docs are enabled.

200.description: Response from the OAuth device authorization endpoint (RFC 8628).

allOf.description: OAuth public client identifier.

anyOf.description: Optional space-delimited registry scopes requested by the client.

200.description: OAuth 2.0 token response containing an access/refresh token pair.

post.summary: Exchange OAuth grant for access token

anyOf.description: Authorization code returned to the loopback callback.
PKCE verifier generated by the CLI.

allOf.description: OAuth client identifier.

anyOf.description: Loopback redirect URI the authorization code was bound to.
The device verification code received from the /device/code endpoint.
Refresh token to exchange for a new token pair.
Optional requested scope for refresh-token exchange.

allOf.description: The access token or refresh token to revoke. Revocation is idempotent.

anyOf.description: Optional RFC 7009 token type hint. Revocation remains non-enumerating.

200.description: Minimal identity response for login checks and CLI whoami.
Your user profile, organizations, and token details.

post.summary: Create an exact browser-reviewed publish authorization request

anyOf.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response for pagination.
Maximum number of tokens to return (1–100, default 50).

200.description: A page of your access tokens.

201.description: Your new access token. The token value is only shown once — save it now.

delete.description: Revokes the access token identified by tokenId.

200.description: Minimal owner summary for machine clients.

get.description: Returns the minimal public owner summary for the provided handle.

post.summary: Yank all currently available extension versions

post.description: Persists submitted package metadata and resolves package and extension attestations.

get.description: Returns pass/fail status. Public, no auth required.

schema.description: Search query string. Use an empty string to list the public catalog.

anyOf.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response for pagination.
Maximum number of results to return (1–100, default 20).

200.description: A page of extensions matching the search query.

get.description: Returns viewer-visible, available, non-yanked extensions using predictable textual relevance by default. Supports structured type, owner, package, license, lifecycle, visibility, and sort filters.

anyOf.description: Number of events to emit (0–100, default 3).
Emit this many events, then terminate the stream with a typed DebugStreamInterrupted failure. Used to exercise client mid-stream failure decoding.

get.description: Experimental diagnostic endpoint. Emits a finite server-sent event stream of sequenced JSON events, optionally terminating with a typed mid-stream failure. Intended for client streaming conformance checks; not a stable product surface.

anyOf.description: Path to the interactive API documentation, or null when docs are disabled.
Path to the OpenAPI specification, or null when docs are disabled.

MetaResponse.title: Meta Response
MetaResponse.description: Registry service metadata including health status and documentation entry points.

device_code.description: Device verification code for the polling client.

user_code.description: Short code the user enters in the browser.

verification_uri.description: URI where the user should navigate to enter the user code.

verification_uri_complete.description: URI with the user code pre-filled, suitable for QR codes or direct links.

allOf.description: Lifetime of the device code in seconds.
Minimum polling interval in seconds.

DeviceCodeResponse.title: Device Code Response
DeviceCodeResponse.description: Response from the OAuth device authorization endpoint (RFC 8628).

retryable.description: Whether the client may retry the request.

allOf.description: Suggested delay in seconds before retrying.

requiredScope.description: The scope required to perform the operation, if applicable.

tokenScopes.description: The scopes present on the token used for the request.

requiredRole.description: The management role required, if applicable.

PublishDetails.title: Publish Details
PublishDetails.description: Extended error details for publish-related and retryable error responses.

ProblemDetails.title: Problem Details
ProblemDetails.description: RFC 9457 Problem Details payload for AgentXM Registry errors.

anyOf.description: OAuth 2.0 refresh token for obtaining new token pairs. Omitted for exact publish capabilities.

allOf.description: Access token lifetime remaining in seconds.

anyOf.description: Space-delimited list of granted scopes.
Publish authorization request that produced a non-refreshable exact capability.

SessionTokenResponse.title: Session Token Response
SessionTokenResponse.description: OAuth 2.0 token response containing an access/refresh token pair.

AuthWhoamiResponse.title: Auth Whoami Response
AuthWhoamiResponse.description: Minimal identity response for login checks and CLI whoami.

allOf.title: User ID
allOf.description: Identifies a registered user account. Assigned at sign-up and referenced by tokens, memberships, and audit trails.

anyOf.description: The user's email address, if available.

extensions.description: Extension patterns this token is limited to, or null if unrestricted.

ResourceRestrictions.title: Resource Restrictions
ResourceRestrictions.description: What this token is allowed to access.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the credential used for this request.

anyOf.description: Human-readable name of the token, if assigned.

permissions.description: Structured permissions associated with this token.

AuthMeToken.title: Token Info
AuthMeToken.description: Details about the token you used to authenticate.

orgs.description: Organizations the user belongs to (reserved, currently empty).

AuthMeResponse.title: Auth Me Response
AuthMeResponse.description: Your user profile, organizations, and token details.

step_up.description: Opaque step-up proof for the original request.

allOf.title: Handle
allOf.description: A unique username or organization name starting with @, like @my-org.

ExtensionType.title: Extension Type
ExtensionType.description: What kind of extension this is: skill, mcp-server, subagent, rule, hook, knowledge, or pack.

allOf.title: Extension Name
allOf.description: The name of an extension — lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens (e.g. my-skill).

allOf.title: Version
allOf.description: A semver version like 1.0.0. Ranges are not allowed here.

allOf.title: Publish Authorization Request ID
allOf.description: Identifies one exact browser-reviewed publish authorization request.

allOf.title: Token ID
allOf.description: Identifies an access token or personal access token (PAT) issued to a user. Used to authenticate API requests to the registry.

anyOf.description: Human-readable name of the token, if assigned.

permissions.description: Structured permissions associated with this token.

tokens.description: List of access tokens for the authenticated user.

has_more.description: Whether additional tokens exist beyond this page.

anyOf.description: Opaque cursor for fetching the next page of results.

TokenListResponse.title: Token List Response
TokenListResponse.description: A page of your access tokens.

requiredScope.description: The scope required to perform the requested operation.

grantedScopes.description: The scopes granted to the current credential.

ScopeCheckDetails.title: Scope Check Details
ScopeCheckDetails.description: Diagnostic details returned when a request is denied due to insufficient scopes.

requiredScope.description: The scope required to perform the requested operation.

tokenScopes.description: The scopes present on the token used for the request.

requiredRole.description: The management role required, if applicable.

AuthorizationDenyDetails.title: Authorization Deny Details
AuthorizationDenyDetails.description: Diagnostic details returned when a request is denied due to insufficient authorization.

owners.description: Owner selectors for extension permissions. Use full handles or "all".

cidr.description: Optional CIDR allowlist for the token.

bypass_mfa.description: Whether this automation token bypasses step-up MFA.

CreateTokenPermissionsRequest.title: Create Token Permissions Request
CreateTokenPermissionsRequest.description: Structured permission request for the token.

allOf.description: Human-readable name for the token.
How long the token lasts, in seconds (1 hour to 365 days).

CreateTokenRequest.title: Create Token Request
CreateTokenRequest.description: Request body for creating a new personal access token.

token.description: The token value — save this, it won't be shown again.

CreateTokenResponse.title: Create Token Response
CreateTokenResponse.description: Your new access token. The token value is only shown once — save it now.

displayName.description: Display name for the owner account.

OwnerResponse.title: Owner Response
OwnerResponse.description: Minimal owner summary for machine clients.

url.description: Canonical repository URL for the extension source.

anyOf.description: Repository type from the manifest, such as git.
Subdirectory containing the extension source.

Repository.title: Repository
Repository.description: Repository details for an extension manifest.

LicenseExpression.title: License Expression
LicenseExpression.description: SPDX license expression, or `UNLICENSED` for proprietary code.

anyOf.description: Display name of the extension author.
Contact email of the extension author.
URL for the extension author (homepage or profile).

Author.title: Author
Author.description: Author details: name, email, and homepage URL.

ExtensionTypePlural.title: Extension Type (Plural)
ExtensionTypePlural.description: Plural form of the extension type used in URLs and identifiers (e.g. skills, hooks, packs).

anyOf.description: Issue tracker URL for the extension.
Contact email for reporting extension issues.

Bugs.title: Bugs
Bugs.description: Bug reporting details for an extension manifest.

allOf.title: Version Range
allOf.description: A semver version range like ^1.0.0, ~2.3.0, >=1.0.0 <3.0.0, or an exact version 1.2.3. Use "*" to always resolve to the latest available version.

allOf.title: Package Identity Purl
allOf.description: A Package URL (purl) identity for a companion package. Companion package purls are identities, not pins: omit the purl @version segment and put compatibility constraints in versionRange.

CompanionPackage.title: Companion Package
CompanionPackage.description: A companion package purl identity with an optional VERS compatibility range.

allOf.title: Extension Deletion Operation ID
allOf.description: Identifies a durable owner-requested whole-Extension deletion operation.

visibility.title: Visibility
visibility.description: Target visibility tier for the extension.

PatchVisibilityBody.title: Patch Visibility Body
PatchVisibilityBody.description: Request body for updating an extension's visibility.

allOf.title: Extension ID
allOf.description: Identifies a registered extension in the registry. An extension groups all published versions under a single handle, type, and name.

ExtensionLinks.title: Extension Links
ExtensionLinks.description: Hyperlinks for an extension resource. `html` is the canonical web page URL.

anyOf.description: Message shown to users explaining why this extension is deprecated.

DeprecateBody.title: Deprecate Body
DeprecateBody.description: Request body for deprecating an extension.

PublishFindingLocation.title: Finding Location
PublishFindingLocation.description: Accessor-relative location of a lint finding.

PublishLintFinding.title: Publish Lint Finding
PublishLintFinding.description: One lint finding produced against the publish subject.

PublishIdentity.title: Publish Identity
PublishIdentity.description: URL-path identity of the extension version under publish.

PublishIdentityMismatchEntry.title: Identity Mismatch Entry
PublishIdentityMismatchEntry.description: Single divergent identity field between URL-path and archive.

YankVersionBody.title: Yank Version Body
YankVersionBody.description: Optional public context for yanking an extension version.

YankAvailableVersionsBody.title: Yank Available Versions Body
YankAvailableVersionsBody.description: Atomically yanks the snapshot of all currently available versions.

confirmation.description: Exact full Extension FQN typed by the owner to confirm deletion.

DeleteExtensionBody.title: Delete Extension Body
DeleteExtensionBody.description: High-intent confirmation for permanent whole-Extension deletion.

allOf.title: Library ID
allOf.description: Identifies an account-owned curated collection of extension identities in the registry.

LibraryName.title: Library Name
LibraryName.description: Canonical Library name within an owner namespace. Uses the same normalized slug grammar as handles.

allOf.title: Library Member ID
allOf.description: Identifies an extension identity membership inside a curated registry library.

allOf.title: Extension FQN
allOf.description: Canonical extension identifier in @owner/<type>s/<name> form.

SearchHit.title: Search Hit
SearchHit.description: A single extension matched by a search query.

extensions.description: Extensions matching the query, ordered by recency.

has_more.description: Whether additional results exist beyond this page.

anyOf.description: Opaque cursor for fetching the next page of results.

allOf.description: Exact number of viewer-visible extensions matching the query.

SearchResponse.title: Search Response
SearchResponse.description: A page of extensions matching the search query.
